results.title: AI and assessment in higher education | THE Campus Learn, Share, Connect
results.content: # AI and assessment in higher education. No sooner had generative AI (GenAI) tools, such as ChatGPT, ignited fears in universities about risk to assessment practices and academic integrity, than academics began working out how to embrace it to save time and enrich student skills such as critical thinking and analysis. This has required consideration of not only how to use artificial intelligence (AI) in future university assessment but also a rethink of past exam, assignment and evaluation practices. This diverse collection of resources includes advice on how to engineer prompts, use AI for authentic assessment design, whether to lean into AI-detection tools, how to build digital literacy and AI’s role in developing soft skills in lifelong learning. From the dependability of AI detectors to common features of AI generated content, these resources explore how academics might identify GenAI input and combat cheating but also whether a new understanding of academic integrity is needed for the digital age.

results.content: # How Professors Detect AI in Academic Writing: A Comprehensive Student Guide. ## Can Professors Detect AI-Written Essays? If you’re wondering, **"Can my professor detect if I used AI?"** the answer is yes. Professors and universities are now actively monitoring AI use in student assignments, utilizing AI detection tools and manual analysis to ensure students are engaging with their work authentically. * How professors detect AI-written content. * The tools they use to catch AI-generated writing. * How to use AI in a way that won’t get you in trouble. By the end of this guide, you’ll know exactly how to avoid academic misconduct while making AI a valuable (and ethical) tool for improving your writing. ## Why Do Professors Check for AI in Academic Writing? As a student, you might wonder why professors are concerned about the use of AI in assignments. Always check your university's guidelines before using AI tools in your work to ensure you're on the right track.
